VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The agent's self-report alone is insufficient to verify that the acceptance criteria have been met. While the report claims all 88 tests pass and describes a plausible fix (per-key mutex with double-checked guard), there is no independent evidence to corroborate:

1. That the tests actually pass (no CI log or test results provided)
2. That the fix was actually implemented (no diff or code artifact provided)
3. That the regression tests were genuinely added (no test code provided)
4. That manual testing under concurrent load was performed (no results provided)

Self-reports are the weakest form of evidence and cannot independently satisfy acceptance criteria requiring objective verification of test passage and code correctness.
